project.name: E-commerce Platform
project.description: [DEMO] Comprehensive test project demonstrating complete TMS functionality. Features realistic e-commerce workflows including authentication, cart management, payment processing, and product catalog flows.

testRun.name: Regression Run - Sprint Snapshot
testRun.description: Full regression cycle for Sprint 24 release candidate. Covers auth, cart, payment, and catalog modules.

suites.name: Authentication
suites.description: Tests covering user login, session management, and password recovery flows.

cases.title: Successful login with valid credentials
cases.description: Verify that a registered user can log in using correct email and password.
cases.preconditions: User account exists with email 'tester@shop.com' and password 'Test@1234'. Application is accessible on Staging.

steps.action: Navigate to https://staging.shop.com/login
steps.expectedResult: Login page is displayed with email and password fields visible

steps.action: Enter email 'tester@shop.com' and password 'Test@1234', click 'Sign In'
steps.expectedResult: Credentials are accepted and the form is submitted

steps.action: Observe the page after authentication
steps.expectedResult: User is redirected to the dashboard; username 'tester' is displayed in the header

cases.title: Login with invalid password
cases.description: Verify that the system blocks login when an incorrect password is entered.
cases.preconditions: User account exists with email 'tester@shop.com'. Application is accessible on Staging.

steps.action: Navigate to https://staging.shop.com/login
steps.expectedResult: Login page is displayed

steps.action: Enter email 'tester@shop.com' and password 'WrongPass!', click 'Sign In'
steps.expectedResult: Form is submitted with incorrect credentials

steps.action: Observe the error message
steps.expectedResult: Error message 'Invalid email or password' is displayed; user remains on the login page

cases.title: Session expiry and auto-logout
cases.description: Verify that an inactive session expires after the configured timeout and the user is logged out.
cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Session timeout is configured to 30 minutes in Staging environment.

steps.action: Log in with valid credentials and navigate to the dashboard
steps.expectedResult: User is successfully authenticated and dashboard is visible

steps.action: Leave the browser idle for 31 minutes without any interaction
steps.expectedResult: No user interaction occurs during the wait period

steps.action: Attempt to navigate to the account settings page
steps.expectedResult: User is redirected to the login page with message 'Your session has expired'

failedStepActualResults.3: Session remains active. User accesses the account settings page without being redirected to the login screen.

cases.title: Password reset via email
cases.description: Verify that the password reset flow sends an email and allows the user to set a new password.
cases.preconditions: User account exists. Email service is configured in Staging. Email inbox is accessible.

steps.action: Navigate to the login page and click 'Forgot password?'
steps.expectedResult: Password reset form is displayed requesting the registered email address

steps.action: Enter 'tester@shop.com' and click 'Send reset link'
steps.expectedResult: Confirmation message 'Check your inbox for a reset link' is displayed

steps.action: Open the reset email and click the reset link
steps.expectedResult: Browser opens the password reset page with a new password form

steps.action: Enter a new password and confirm it, then click 'Reset password'
steps.expectedResult: Password is updated; user is redirected to the login page with success message

suites.name: Shopping Cart
suites.description: Tests covering add-to-cart, quantity updates, coupon codes, and cart persistence.

cases.title: Add product to cart
cases.description: Verify that a user can add a product from the catalog to the shopping cart.
cases.preconditions: User is logged in. At least one in-stock product exists in the catalog.

steps.action: Navigate to the product catalog and open any in-stock product detail page
steps.expectedResult: Product detail page is displayed with 'Add to Cart' button enabled

steps.action: Click 'Add to Cart'
steps.expectedResult: Product is added; cart icon in the header shows item count increased by 1

steps.action: Open the cart page
steps.expectedResult: The product appears in the cart with correct name, price, and quantity of 1

cases.title: Update item quantity in cart
cases.description: Verify that the user can change the quantity of an item already in the cart.
cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Cart contains at least one product with quantity 1.

steps.action: Open the cart page
steps.expectedResult: Cart page displays the product with current quantity 1

steps.action: Change the quantity selector for the product to 3
steps.expectedResult: Quantity field updates to 3

steps.action: Click 'Update cart'
steps.expectedResult: Cart subtotal updates to reflect 3× the unit price; no page errors

cases.title: Remove item from cart
cases.description: Verify that the user can remove a product from the shopping cart.
cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Cart contains exactly one product.

steps.action: Open the cart page
steps.expectedResult: Cart displays the product with a 'Remove' button

steps.action: Click 'Remove' next to the product
steps.expectedResult: Product is removed from the cart

steps.action: Observe the cart state
steps.expectedResult: 'Your cart is empty' message is displayed; cart icon shows 0 items

cases.title: Cart persistence after page reload
cases.description: Verify that cart contents are preserved when the user reloads the browser.
cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Cart contains 2 different products.

steps.action: Open the cart page and note the list of products
steps.expectedResult: Cart displays 2 products with correct quantities and prices

steps.action: Reload the browser page (F5)
steps.expectedResult: Page reloads and cart still displays the same 2 products with unchanged quantities

steps.action: Verify the cart total matches the pre-reload total
steps.expectedResult: Cart subtotal is identical to the value observed before reload

failedStepActualResults.2: After reload in Safari 17.4, the cart is empty. Products are lost on page refresh. Reproducible 100% of the time on Safari; Chrome and Firefox are unaffected.

cases.title: Apply discount coupon code
cases.description: Verify that a valid coupon code applies a discount to the cart total.
cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Cart contains at least one product. Coupon 'SAVE20' for 20% off is active in the system.

steps.action: Open the cart page
steps.expectedResult: Cart displays the coupon code input field

steps.action: Enter 'SAVE20' in the coupon field and click 'Apply'
steps.expectedResult: Coupon is accepted; confirmation 'Coupon applied' is shown

steps.action: Verify the cart total
steps.expectedResult: Cart total is reduced by 20%; discount line item shows '-20%' applied

suites.name: Payment & Checkout
suites.description: Tests covering the end-to-end checkout flow, payment processing, and order confirmation.

cases.title: Checkout with valid credit card
cases.description: Verify that the user can complete a purchase using a valid credit card.
cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Cart contains at least one product. Test credit card 4111111111111111 (Visa) is configured in Stripe test mode.

steps.action: Proceed to checkout from the cart page
steps.expectedResult: Checkout page displays shipping address and payment sections

steps.action: Fill in a valid shipping address and click 'Continue to Payment'
steps.expectedResult: Payment section becomes active; card input form is displayed

steps.action: Enter card number 4111111111111111, expiry 12/26, CVV 123 and click 'Place Order'
steps.expectedResult: Order is processed successfully

steps.action: Observe the confirmation screen
steps.expectedResult: Order confirmation page displays order number, summary, and estimated delivery date

cases.title: Checkout with expired credit card
cases.description: Verify that the system rejects payment with an expired credit card and shows an appropriate error.
cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Cart contains at least one product.

steps.action: Proceed to checkout and navigate to the payment step
steps.expectedResult: Payment form is displayed

steps.action: Enter card number 4000000000000069 (expired test card), expiry 01/20, CVV 123 and click 'Place Order'
steps.expectedResult: Payment request is submitted with the expired card

steps.action: Observe the error feedback
steps.expectedResult: Error message 'Your card has expired. Please use a different card.' is displayed; user remains on the payment page

cases.title: Order confirmation email delivery
cases.description: Verify that the system sends an order confirmation email after a successful purchase.
cases.preconditions: User is logged in with email 'tester@shop.com'. Cart contains one product. Email service is configured in Staging.

steps.action: Complete a successful checkout using the valid test credit card
steps.expectedResult: Order confirmation page is displayed with an order number

steps.action: Open the inbox for 'tester@shop.com' within 2 minutes
steps.expectedResult: Order confirmation email is received from 'orders@shop.com'

steps.action: Open the email and verify its content
steps.expectedResult: Email contains order number, itemised product list, total amount, and estimated delivery date

cases.title: Guest checkout flow
cases.description: Verify that an unauthenticated user can complete a purchase as a guest.
cases.preconditions: User is not logged in. At least one in-stock product exists.

steps.action: Add a product to cart without logging in and proceed to checkout
steps.expectedResult: Checkout page offers 'Continue as Guest' option alongside login

steps.action: Click 'Continue as Guest', enter email 'guest@example.com' and shipping details
steps.expectedResult: Guest checkout form accepts the details without requiring account creation

steps.action: Complete payment using the valid test credit card
steps.expectedResult: Order is placed; confirmation page displays order number and a prompt to create an account

cases.title: Payment gateway timeout handling
cases.description: Verify that the system handles a payment gateway timeout gracefully and shows a user-friendly error.
cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Cart contains one product. Staging environment is configured with a simulated 30-second gateway timeout for card 4000000000000341.

steps.action: Proceed to checkout and navigate to the payment step
steps.expectedResult: Payment form is displayed

steps.action: Enter the timeout-simulation card number 4000000000000341 and click 'Place Order'
steps.expectedResult: Payment request is submitted; loading indicator is shown

steps.action: Wait for the gateway response (up to 35 seconds)
steps.expectedResult: After timeout, the system should display a user-friendly error message

steps.action: Observe the error message and page state
steps.expectedResult: Message 'Payment could not be processed. Please try again or contact support.' is displayed; cart is preserved

failedStepActualResults.4: The page displays a generic HTTP 500 Internal Server Error page. The cart is cleared. No user-friendly message is shown. Browser console shows an unhandled promise rejection.

suites.name: Product Catalog
suites.description: Tests covering product search, filtering, product detail pages, and stock status display.

cases.title: Product search by keyword
cases.description: Verify that the search feature returns relevant results for a given keyword.
cases.preconditions: Application is accessible. Catalog contains products including 'Wireless Headphones'.

steps.action: Click the search bar in the header and type 'Wireless Headphones'
steps.expectedResult: Search input accepts the text

steps.action: Press Enter or click the search icon
steps.expectedResult: Search results page loads

steps.action: Verify the results list
steps.expectedResult: At least one result matching 'Wireless Headphones' is displayed with name, price, and thumbnail

cases.title: Filter products by category and price range
cases.description: Verify that the filter panel correctly narrows results by category and maximum price.
cases.preconditions: User is on the catalog page. Products exist in the 'Electronics' category with prices ranging from $20 to $500.

steps.action: Open the catalog page and expand the filter panel
steps.expectedResult: Filter panel displays category checkboxes and a price range slider

steps.action: Select category 'Electronics' and set max price to $100, then click 'Apply Filters'
steps.expectedResult: Filter is applied; URL updates with filter parameters

steps.action: Review the product grid
steps.expectedResult: Only products from the 'Electronics' category with price ≤ $100 are displayed

cases.title: Product detail page rendering
cases.description: Verify that all required elements are present and correctly rendered on a product detail page.
cases.preconditions: Catalog contains at least one product with images, description, price, and stock status.

steps.action: Click on any product in the catalog grid
steps.expectedResult: Product detail page opens with URL containing the product slug/ID

steps.action: Verify all required elements are present
steps.expectedResult: Page displays: product name, at least one image, price, stock status, description, and 'Add to Cart' button

steps.action: Check the image gallery interaction
steps.expectedResult: Clicking thumbnail images updates the main product image without page reload

cases.title: Out-of-stock product display
cases.description: Verify that out-of-stock products are clearly indicated and cannot be added to the cart.
cases.preconditions: At least one product exists in the catalog with stock quantity set to 0.

steps.action: Navigate to a product detail page for an out-of-stock product
steps.expectedResult: Product detail page is displayed

steps.action: Observe the stock status and cart button
steps.expectedResult: 'Out of Stock' badge is visible; 'Add to Cart' button is disabled or replaced with 'Notify Me'

steps.action: Attempt to click the disabled cart button
steps.expectedResult: No action is taken; product is not added to the cart

defects.title: Session token not invalidated after configured timeout period
defects.description: The server-side session token remains valid after 30 minutes of inactivity. The user is not redirected to the login page, allowing continued access to authenticated routes. This is a security risk as unattended browser sessions remain active indefinitely.

defects.title: Cart items lost on page refresh in Safari 17.x
defects.description: When a user reloads the shopping cart page in Safari 17.4 on macOS, all cart items are removed. The localStorage key 'cart_v2' is cleared on reload in Safari only. Chrome 123 and Firefox 124 are unaffected. Issue is 100% reproducible in Safari private and normal windows.

defects.title: Payment gateway timeout returns HTTP 500 instead of user-friendly error
defects.description: When the Stripe payment gateway does not respond within 30 seconds, the application throws an unhandled exception and renders a raw HTTP 500 error page. The cart is cleared during this process. The expected behaviour is a graceful error message and cart preservation.

report.name: Sprint 24 Regression Report
report.description: Automated regression report for Sprint 24 release candidate (v2.4.1). Covers all four functional areas: Authentication, Shopping Cart, Payment & Checkout, and Product Catalog.
